A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DualOptim study and contain readable main text and Appendices A-C. Tables, figures, equations and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original DualOptim experiments for image classification, image generation and LLM unlearning, with additional experiments and ablations in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds NPO+GD comparisons, Muon ablations, and runtime and memory measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3.4 and Algorithm 1 retain alternating forgetting and retaining updates with separate optimizer states and adaptive learning rates for forgetting. Muon configurations are additional ablations, without revising the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN and TinyImageNet classification, CIFAR-10 and ImageNet generation, and TOFU unlearning. The additional measurements retain existing tasks and coverage; LoRA experiments already appear in v1.

E2.justification: v2 adds NPO+GD to the Phi-1.5 and LLaMA 2 comparisons in Table 4 and the LoRA comparison in Table 16, corresponding to v1 Table 15. It also adds three Muon-based optimizer combinations in Table 6. Existing comparators are retained.

E3.justification: New Table 5 introduces runtime and memory evaluation in minutes and GB/GPU for Adam versus DualOptim under full-parameter tuning and LoRA. Existing task metrics, forgetting fractions and training budgets remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish revisions to those experiments.

E4.justification: The optimizer-choice ablation expands from v1 Table 5 to v2 Table 6 with three Muon combinations. New Table 5 examines resource costs under full tuning and LoRA. Existing moment-decoupling, momentum-coefficient and update-scheme analyses are retained, including relocated appendix material.

E5.justification: Both versions retain five-trial mean and standard deviation reporting for classification and the same rule for omitting small LLM standard deviations. Added optimizer rows use the existing uncertainty format; no changed repetition counts, seed reporting or statistical tests are documented.

E6.justification: v2 adds NPO+GD scores, Muon ablation results and resource measurements while retaining the earlier benchmark results. Table 1 also corrects the CIFAR-10 SFRon+DualOptim FA gap from 0.02 to 0.08; its reported FA remains 94.69.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.3 adds a Lipschitz assumption, corollary and proof transferring parameter-variance bounds to performance-metric variance. The central theorem is retained. v2 also changes the correlation-assumption wording from negligible to non-positive and corrects a decoupled-momentum term in Equation 11.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims of a plug-and-play method improving unlearning efficacy and stability across classification, generation and LLM tasks. The additions support these existing claims without redefining their scope.

C2.justification: The interpretation of Figure 4 changes from low correlation to non-positive correlation, and Appendix A.3 connects parameter stability to metric stability conditionally. Where v1 already acknowledges resource overhead, v2 quantifies it and explicitly identifies doubled optimizer-state memory as a remaining limitation.

D1.justification: The abstract adds a code-repository link. Table 5 specifies DeepSpeed ZeRO stage 2 for full tuning and a single H20 GPU for LoRA resource measurements. Existing Appendix B hyperparameters are retained; the repository's contents or availability were not externally verified.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Negative Preference Optimization by Zhang et al. and Muon by Jordan et al., accompanying the added comparisons. The broader related-work discussion and positioning of DualOptim remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main section sequence are retained. Changes include local copyediting, affiliation text, brief limitations and funding sections, and moving the unlearning-process discussion from Appendix C.6 to C.2.

P2.justification: v2 reformats the document throughout into the NeurIPS style, changing typography, title and author layout, and spacing. Tables 2 and 4 replace wide side-by-side blocks with larger stacked panels; a resource table is added and appendix displays are extensively reflowed. Figure 8 now places panels (g)-(j) before (a)-(f), although the image content is retained.

improvement.justification: The added NPO+GD comparisons, Muon ablations, code-access information and resource measurements improve validation and practical transparency. Appendix A.3 adds conditional support connecting parameter and metric stability. These gains are limited and partly offset by a new inconsistency in Table 5: the LoRA timings 62.32 and 26.76 minutes imply a ratio of about 2.33, whereas the table reports 1.21.
